author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Doctors reported a case of "Happy Heart Syndrome," a rare form of Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy triggered by extreme positive emotions such as joy. This condition causes the heart's left ventricle to balloon and mimic a heart attack, though it is reversible with proper treatment.

Source Article: https://academic.oup.com/omcr/article/2026/7/omag108/8728303
